The role sits at the intersection of Business, Tax, Finance, Procurement and IT and requires someone who can bring together different functional and technical teams around the SAP DRC and e-invoicing activities.

We are looking for a strong delivery professional with a solid SAP technical background and hands-on experience in SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and e-invoicing implementations. The focus of the role is not primarily on configuration, but on coordinating the different teams, managing dependencies and driving the workstream toward successful delivery.

Project Conditions:

  • Start: Mid-November / beginning of December 2026

  • Contract: Freelance

  • Duration: Expected until mid-October 2027

  • Workload: 0.5–1.0 FTE, most likely ramping up toward full-time

  • Location: Budapest

  • Working model: Remote (Hungary)

  • Language: Fluent English

Tasks

  • Coordinate the SAP DRC / e-invoicing workstream across multiple Business and IT teams.

  • Drive alignment between Finance, Tax, SD, MM, Procure-to-Pay / purchasing and payment processes and the relevant technical teams.

  • Manage cross-functional dependencies, priorities, risks and open topics across the e-invoicing activities.

  • Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, functional SAP teams and technical IT teams.

  • Support planning, coordination and execution of the e-invoicing implementation within the broader S/4HANA transformation.

  • Ensure transparency around progress, dependencies, decisions and potential delivery risks.

  • Facilitate meetings, workshops and working sessions across distributed international teams.

  • Support backlog, action and delivery tracking and ensure that agreed next steps are followed through.

  • Act as a central coordination point for the different teams involved in the e-invoicing solution.

  • Work closely with the respective workstream and program/workstream leadership to ensure alignment with the overall transformation roadmap.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in project delivery, workstream coordination or Scrum Master responsibilities within complex SAP or IT transformation programs.

  • Experience coordinating multiple Business and IT teams in an international environment.

  • Strong SAP background and a good understanding of complex SAP landscapes and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Experience with SAP DRC / Document and Reporting Compliance.

  • Experience with e-invoicing implementations, ideally having already supported or led the implementation of an SAP DRC e-invoicing solution or related workstream.

  • Good cross-functional understanding across SAP SD, FI/Finance, MM and Tax.

  • Understanding of Procure-to-Pay processes and their interaction with Finance, Tax and e-invoicing.

  • Strong delivery and leadership capabilities gained in roles such as Scrum Master, Project Manager, Workstream Lead, Product Owner or Solution Lead.

  • Ability to understand both business requirements and technical dependencies and translate between different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong organizational, facilitation and communication skills.

  • Proactive, structured and hands-on working style.

  • Experience working with distributed international teams.

  • Fluent English is mandatory.

  • Previous experience within the client's organization or transformation program would be a strong advantage.

Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Meta (all genders)
jobs.description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Meta product domain and help shape the experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform.

At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game.

In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.

What sets this role apart?

You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain

  • Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

  • Drive complex product problems with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the opportunity through launch, measurement, and iteration

  • Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Data game teams, and other Product team members to shape solutions, align on priorities, and bring impactful features to life.

Job Requirements

Job Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

  • Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

  • Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

  • Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

  • Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

  • Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

  • Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

  • Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

  • Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

  • Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

  • Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.

Nice-to-haves

  • Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

  • Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

  • Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code

You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.

Location & work mode

Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.

What you'll do

  • Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure
  • Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow
  • Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself
  • Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves
  • Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap
  • Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it
  • Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships
  • Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you
  • Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years experience in Product Management in B2B SaaS
  • Background in Software Engineering
  • A track record of shipping things people actually use
  • Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience
  • Exceptional product and operational judgement
  • Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus
  • Shameless customer obsession
  • Extreme clarity in writing and thinking
  • Speed without sloppiness

jobs.title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.description:
About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

  • Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

  • Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

  • Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

  • 6+ years in product management

  • Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

  • AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

  • Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

  • Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

  • Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

  • Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

  • You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

  • Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

  • A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Document or file-processing products

  • A utility business with a strong free tier

  • Experience with high-volume consumer tools

  • Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate.

Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact!

Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.

Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values.

Our Benefits

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond.

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents

🐶 Don’t leave your four-legged friends at home, our offices are pet-friendly

📚 A personal development budget of up to 2,000 CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training.

🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills.

👩‍💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

🍻 BBQs, game nights, meetups in the Swiss Alps, or in kayaks on Lake Zurich—we’re serious about great coffee, karaoke, and Mario Kart, too!

How to Apply

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

Hiring policy

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process.

We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table.

RWE Delivery Manager - France/Germany
jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words: you will lead the end-to-end delivery of Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies in Germany & France, connecting clinical research, remote monitoring and health data. You will own execution: timelines, budgets, site and partner coordination, deliverable quality and the sponsor relationship.

Your impact: make studies work in practice and generate reliable evidence for oncology and haematology research. The site relationships, methods and tools you build should also make future studies easier to deliver.

Your day to day:

  • Lead studies from contracting to the final report, including protocol and statistical analysis plan coordination, ethics submissions, data collection and deliverables.

  • Maintain an actionable project timeline, anticipate risks and propose solutions before milestones are affected.

  • Track study budgets, committed expenditure, site costs and clinical research organisation (CRO) costs.

  • Select and activate sites with local teams, coordinate site contracting and oversee CRO partners.

  • Act as the sponsor’s primary operational contact and lead steering committees with international pharmaceutical partners.

  • Work with Medical, Clinical Operations, Data, Legal and Quality teams, and turn delivery experience into reusable methods.

✨ Your Team

  • Your future colleagues:

    • you’ll work closely with Mehdi, Project Manager RWE, on study delivery and shared project-management practices, and with Maxime and Eugénie, Global Pharma Partners, to connect pharmaceutical partners’ needs with practical study execution.

  • Your manager:

    • you’ll report to Adil, RWE Lead, who leads Resilience’s Real-World Evidence activities. Adil gives you room to own your projects, with clear priorities and support when decisions need to be made. He values early communication, practical solutions and following through on commitments.

  • The little ➕ about your team:

    • when the Life Sciences team gets together, Italian food is our go-to, a small tradition we’re happy to share with new colleagues.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Lead a clinical or non-interventional study end to end, understanding the dependencies between each stage.

  • Navigate the German research environment: ethics committees, GDPR/DSGVO, Länder-level data protection requirements and hospital contracting.

  • Oversee a CRO and its deliverables, with a clear understanding of sponsor responsibilities, pharmacovigilance and monitoring plans.

  • Track a study budget and make variances, risks and necessary trade-offs visible.

  • Assess clinical data quality and discuss electronic health record structuring and AI-assisted extraction.

  • Work fluently in German and use professional English in writing and speaking.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A strong sense of ownership: you follow work through to results rather than stopping at coordination.

  • Structured working habits that leave room for anticipation and process improvement.

  • The reflex to flag risks early, alongside a proposed course of action.

  • Clear communication with scientific, operational and commercial stakeholders.

  • Composure when plans change and autonomy in an international, distributed setting.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Managed clinical or non-interventional studies with direct responsibility for timelines and deliverables.

  • Worked with investigator sites and research partners in the German ecosystem.

  • Overseen a CRO from the sponsor side.

  • Tracked research project costs and budgets.

  • Coordinated cross-functional teams and presented project progress to a sponsor or pharmaceutical partners.

It’s a plus if you have delivered studies in oncology or haematology.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to research grounded in real care pathways, working with sites and medical teams.

  • Lead studies that combine remote monitoring, patient-reported outcomes and clinical data.

  • Own projects end to end, with responsibility for execution and results.

  • Build lasting methods and partnerships with an international, multidisciplinary team.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Screening with Elena - 15 min: discuss your motivation and the role’s prerequisites.

  2. Manager Fit with Adill - 30min: to dive deeper into your background and product vision

  3. Case Study with Adil, and members of Team Medic — Format: a business case sent a few days in advance, followed by a live presentation and Q&A.

  4. Team Fit with Mehdi, Eugénie, Ivan, Daniel, Sebastien — 30 min/itw : collaboration fit

  5. Strategic Fit with Lucas - 30min

Your mission

This is not a normal job. Please read this part before you read anything else.

If you are highly driven, extremely ambitious, and you want to do the work of your life at a company that will change how people get access to new therapies and shared medical knowledge, mama health is the place for you.

If not, this role is not for you. This is why:

  • You will be in the office 5 days a week. Berlin HQ. Not hybrid. Not "flexible". We build together, in the same room, every day.
  • You will work a lot. More than at most jobs. We do not count hours, we count what we ship and what it changes for patients.
  • You will give some of the best years of your life to this. In return, you get ownership, speed, and a problem worth your time.
  • You will get obsessed with metrics. Not dashboards for a weekly meeting. Real obsession: why did this number move, what does it mean for a patient, what do we change tomorrow.

Why do we ask this much? Because today, patients spend years to reach the right therapy. We want to help every patient reach their best possible care faster: understand their own situation, get clear information about it, and get access to the best tools, therapies, and treatments in the world. This is generational work not work for everyone. It will change your life and the lives of millions of other people.


This role is built to grow into Head of Product. How fast depends on you.

- - - - - 


As a Product Manager at mama health, you will shape and execute product of one of the most exciting AI companies in healthcare. You will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, and medical experts to build products that help patients understand their diseases, and that help healthcare organizations learn directly from patient experiences at scale.

This is an execution role. You will be expected to take ownership, turn ambitious goals into shipped products, and keep a high pace.

You will be responsible for driving product development from idea to launch while ensuring alignment across teams and maintaining a high pace of execution.

You will:

  • Own product initiatives from discovery to delivery and iteration
  • Write your own SQL queries, build your own analyses, and find the "why" behind every metric
  • Define success metrics for everything you ship, and own the result
  • Translate company goals into clear priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans

Your profile

  • You learn fast and you like to be out of your comfort zone
  • Clear communication with engineers, designers, and business people
  • Fluent English is required. German is a nice to have.

Why us?

  • Delivery & Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übersetzt du validierte Probleme in wirksame Lösungen, priorisierst entlang klarer Ziele und misst kontinuierlich den Erfolg deiner Initiativen. Was keinen Mehrwert schafft, wird konsequent hinterfragt oder gestoppt.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht:
  • Klare End-to-End-Verantwortung statt Feature-Abarbeitung,
  • starke Kundennähe als zentraler Erfolgsfaktor,
  • hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Entscheidungskompetenz,
  • Fokus auf Wirkung, nicht auf Output.


Dein Profil

Unser Team ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Deshalb suchen wir eine erfahrene Person im Produktmanagement, die Kundennähe mit Klarheit, Entscheidungsstärke und einem hohen Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein verbindet. Du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenzubringen, konstruktiv zu challengen und Veränderungen gemeinsam mit anderen erfolgreich voranzutreiben.

Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • ein hohes Maß an Ownership, Entscheidungsstärke und Ergebnisorientierung,
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit crossfunktionalen Teams,
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Souveränität im Stakeholder-Management: Klarheit schaffen, Prioritäten überzeugend vertreten, Annahmen konstruktiv hinterfragen und auch begründet „Nein“ sagen können,
  • die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenzubringen, Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen und Veränderungen sowohl mit Fingerspitzengefühl sowie manchmal auch mit einer gesunden Portion Beharrlichkeit gemeinsam mit anderen erfolgreich voranzutreiben,
  • Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools, z. B. für Prototyping,
  • sehr gute Deutsch- (C2) und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2),
  • nice to have: Erfahrung in UX, Service Design oder User Research.

HEADLINE:

APEXX is pioneering payment orchestration, transforming the global payments landscape with cutting-edge technology and innovation. As a leader in Fintech, we're committed to excellence, driving forward-thinking solutions that empower businesses worldwide.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own APEXX's Self-Service & Onboarding domain. You will define and execute the product strategy that enables customers to onboard, configure, manage, and optimise their use of APEXX services independently, creating a scalable self-service experience that gives customers greater control and accelerates time-to-value.

This is a highly cross-functional role working across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, and Compliance to create scalable digital experiences that improve customer satisfaction and business efficiency.

You will own the end-to-end onboarding journey - from account creation and KYC/KYB orchestration to payment provider configuration, user management, and self-service administration - as part of a broader vision to give customers greater control over how they configure, manage, and optimise their use of the APEXX platform.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for APEXX's self-service capabilities and Customer Portal, starting with the end-to-end merchant onboarding experience and progressively expanding customer control across the platform.

  • Evolve the APEXX Customer Portal into a high-performing, intuitive, and flexible platform that enables customers to understand their payments through actionable data-driven insights and recommendations, and take meaningful actions directly within the platform.

  • Design and deliver scalable self-service capabilities spanning merchant onboarding, account and user administration, API credential management, payment provider configuration, routing rules, and wider platform configuration.

  • Drive Product-Led Growth initiatives that increase adoption of APEXX capabilities, enable customers to expand their use of the platform, and unlock new commercial and market opportunities.

  • Use customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to understand complex enterprise needs, identify opportunities, prioritise roadmap investments, and measure customer and business outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Compliance, and Operations to translate customer needs and product strategy into secure, scalable, performant, and intuitive experiences.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI to simplify complex workflows, automate repetitive processes, surface actionable insights and recommendations, and provide intelligent in-product guidance.

ABOUT YOU:

  • Proven track record in Product Management within SaaS, platform, fintech, or similarly complex digital products, with end-to-end ownership from discovery and strategy through delivery and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience owning and delivering sophisticated customer-facing portals, self-service capabilities, onboarding journeys, or platform configuration products, ideally within complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong product and systems thinking, with the ability to turn complex customer and operational workflows into intuitive, scalable, and reusable product capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of Product-Led Growth, with experience using product capabilities and customer experience to drive adoption, expansion, and commercial growth.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven approach, with experience using customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to inform decisions, prioritise effectively, and measure outcomes.

  • Strong product judgement and commercial awareness, with the ability to balance customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform scalability when making product decisions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence decisions, and work effectively across Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Compliance, and Operations.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services would be highly advantageous.

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.

🏖️ Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.*

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance which includes optical & dental to help support you when it matters most.

🛡️ Life Insurance & Critical Illness Protection: Additional protection for you and your loved ones when it’s needed most.

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE:

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration.

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/apexx.global/?hl=en

Main Website: https://apexx.global/

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:

REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.

This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.

Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.

You will own how we get there.

You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:

Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning.

You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers, raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.

You won’t be managing the process from the sidelines. You’ll be in the details with customers, PMs, engineers and designers, making decisions and helping the team ship.

What you’ll do

  • Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

  • Lead and develop the Product team: Manage 2–3 PMs, help them sharpen their judgment and execution, and establish a consistently high bar for product work.

  • Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

  • Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

  • Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

  • Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

  • Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

  • Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

What we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product.

  • Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers.

  • Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

  • Have owned product delivery across multiple squads or product areas.

  • Have strong product judgment and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Are genuinely AI-forward: you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

We’ll be especially excited if you

  • Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

  • Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs.

  • Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

  • Have experienced both sides of the journey: building product in an early-stage environment and later helping a product organization scale.

Why REMATIQ?

  • A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product systems and ways of working for our next stage are still yours to shape.

  • Real product ownership: You’ll have genuine authority over prioritization, product definition and execution, while staying close enough to the work to personally influence what gets built.

  • Player-coach by design: This isn’t a role where leadership means leaving product craft behind. You’ll build the team while continuing to own meaningful product problems yourself.

  • AI is the product and the way we work: You’ll help define what an AI-native product organization should actually look like, rather than simply adding AI tools to traditional processes.

  • Complex problems worth solving: Our customers operate in environments where workflows are technical, regulated and mission-critical. The product challenges are correspondingly deep.

  • Work directly with the people shaping the company: Partner closely with the founders, Engineering and Design on the decisions that determine what REMATIQ becomes.

  • Meaningful impact: Better software can help medical innovators reduce manual work, navigate complexity and bring important products to market faster and more safely.

  • Compensation and ownership: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a meaningful stake in the company you’re helping to build.

jobs.description:
Wer wir sind.

Eine der führenden Kommunikationsagenturen im deutschen Raum mit mehr als 300 Mitarbeiter*innen. Wir bieten the full monty: Konzeption, Kreation, Redaktion, Organisation, Kampagnen, Social-Media und technologische Plattformen. Wir begleiten Kund*innen aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Gesellschaft und Medien. Und wir entwickeln alles, was diese für eine wirksame Kommunikation brauchen: Social Media-Kampagnen, Magazine, Fernsehspots und Websites. Von der strategischen Kernidee bis zur technischen Umsetzung. Am liebsten für die komplexen Themen unserer Zeit.
 
Die Position des*r Client Service Director ist bei RYSM INTEGRAL angesiedelt – die Digital Experience Unit der RYSM Agenturgruppe. Die Schwerpunkte von RYSM INTEGRAL sind Digital Strategie, CX-Beratung, Plattformen & Services, Datenportale & Websites.


Was zu tun ist.

Du möchtest nicht einzelne Digitalprojekte betreuen, sondern die Verantwortung für ein großes, langfristiges Kundenmandat übernehmen? Als Client Service Director trägst du bei uns die strategische, wirtschaftliche und kundenbezogene Gesamtverantwortung für eines unserer zentralen Mandate im Public Sector – an der Schnittstelle von Kund*innenberatung, Account Development und digitaler Delivery, unterstützt von einem erfahrenen Team aus Projektmanagement, Beratung, UX/UI, Technologie und Betrieb.
 
Was du verantwortest

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Entscheider*innen und zentralen Ansprechpartner*innen
  • Tiefgreifendes Verständnis der Ziele, Roadmaps und Herausforderungen unserer Kund*innen, frühzeitige Reaktion und Lösungsvorschläge statt auf fertige Anfragen zu warten
  • Proaktive Entwicklung neuer Themen und Beratungsangebote (z. B. Plattform-Weiterentwicklung, UX, Technologie, Redaktionsprozesse, KI)
  • Verantwortung für Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag und Forecast
  • Übergeordnete Begleitung großer Projekte, Unterstützung der Projektmanager*innen bei Meilensteinen und Eskalationen
  • Ausrichtung des kund*innenbezogenen Kernteams, Einbindung passender Spezialist*innen
  • Erkennen von Synergien, damit erfolgreiche Lösungen auch an anderer Stelle Mehrwert schaffen
  • Die operative Projektleitung liegt bei unseren Projektmanager*innen – du behältst die Perspektive auf das Gesamtmandat.


Was du mitbringst.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Digitalagentur, Digitalberatung oder vergleichbarem Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Auftraggeber*innen und Verständnis für Verwaltung und öffentliche Kommunikation
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung anspruchsvoller Kund*innen sowie mit größeren Website-, CMS- oder Plattformprojekten
  • Wirtschaftliches und unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägtes Gespür für Kund*innenbedarfe
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, Fähigkeit, Teams auch ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung auszurichten
  • Gutes technisches Grundverständnis; TYPO3-Kenntnisse von Vorteil, keine Voraussetzung
  • Du musst heute noch keinen vergleichbaren Großaccount vollständig verantwortet haben – die Position eignet sich auch als nächster Schritt für erfahrene Senior Consultants, Account Manager*innen oder Senior Project Manager*innen mit dem Wunsch nach mehr strategischer und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung.

Was die Rolle besonders macht
  • Ein großes, langfristig angelegtes Mandat mit erheblichem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Ein festes Kernteam, das du um weitere Spezialist*innen ergänzen kannst.
  • Die Möglichkeit, komplexe digitale Plattformen über mehrere Jahre hinweg mitzuprägen – statt möglichst viele Projekte selbst zu managen.
  • Für die Rolle ist regelmäßige persönliche Präsenz beim Kunden wichtig – daher suchen wir insbesondere jemanden mit Wohnsitz oder dauerhaftem beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz.


Wen wir suchen.

Eine*n Client Service Director für den Public Sector. Ab sofort. Mit beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz


Was wir bieten.

Keine Schokoriegel, sondern digitale Erlebnisse. Keine Turnschuhe, sondern Fitness für die graue Zellen. Weil: komplexe Themen – anspruchsvolle Kund*innen.

Und die Chance, gemeinsam mit uns kräftig aufs Gas zu drücken. Wir stehen für familienfreundliches Arbeiten. Hybrid Work. Raum für individuelle Weiterentwicklung und fachbezogene Veranstaltungen. Und obendrauf mit RYSM INTEGRAL Teil der Hirschen Group und auf internationaler Ebene Partner von WPP zu sein.

Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

jobs.title: Data Analyst, ML & Experimentation (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages Tensorflow and PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

What you will do:

  • Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams.

  • Investigate how our ML models perform in the real world and compare model assumptions and predictions with actual user and business behavior. Identify gaps between offline model performance and online outcomes and help the team close them.

  • Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact, working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes.

  • Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact.

  • Build dashboards and automated reports that make ML model performance, experiments and key business metrics transparent and easy to understand for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Act as a bridge between Data Science, Product and Business teams, translating business questions into analytical problems and turning complex ML insights into clear recommendations and decisions.

  • Challenge product and technical decisions with data, bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy.

  • Document your analyses, methodologies and findings and build reusable analytical approaches that can be applied across models and experiments.

Who you are:

  • You have a degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, economics, analytics, or a similar quantitative field.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, Data Science or a similar role. Experience in AdTech, mobile apps or ML-driven products is a strong plus.

  • You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy digging into data to understand why something happens, not just what happened.

  • You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large datasets.

  • You have strong Python or R skills and are comfortable using them for data analysis and statistical modelling.

  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance and A/B test analysis.

  • You have an understanding of machine learning concepts and model evaluation and are comfortable working with Data Scientists. You don't necessarily need to build ML models yourself, but you should understand how to assess their performance and limitations.

  • You have experience working with model and business metrics, and can connect technical model performance to real-world business outcomes.

  • You have excellent data visualization skills and experience building dashboards using tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, R Shiny, Streamlit or similar.

  • You are comfortable communicating complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

  • Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

  • Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

  • Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

  • Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

  • Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

First 6–12 months

  • Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

  • Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

  • Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

  • By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

  • Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

  • Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

  • Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

  • Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

  • Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

  • Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

  • Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.

Recruitment Process

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager
